RealityScan

RealityScan supports photogrammetric reconstruction and 3D model creation from image sets.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Align an image set

Begin with the selected scans, photographs or measured geometry and coordinate basis. In the intended RealityScan preview, align an image set; the visible result is an aligned capture set with coverage and registration state visible. Review scale, overlap, control points and residual error before accepting or exporting it.

Reconstruct a textured mesh

Use the cleaned capture and nominal reference. In the intended RealityScan preview, reconstruct a textured mesh; the visible result is a segmented, reconstructed or compared geometry result. Review noise, holes, alignment strategy and tolerance basis before accepting or exporting it.

Export a reviewed 3D asset

Start from the reviewed mesh, surface, cloud or inspection characteristics. In the intended RealityScan preview, export a reviewed 3D asset; the visible result is an export or report tied to the captured source and coordinate system. Review deviation limits, completeness, units and downstream fitness before accepting or exporting it.
